    Descent of modules and maps carrying a semilinear Galois action #

    source
    structure EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.DescentAction (k F R : Type u) [Field k] [Field F] [Algebra k F] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] (N : FGModuleCat (ExtendedAlgebra k F R)) :
    Type u

    A Galois action semilinear over the extended field and linear over the original algebra.

    • action : Gal(F/k) →* AddMonoid.End ↑N

      The additive action of the Galois group.

    • map_field_smul (σ : Gal(F/k)) (c : F) (x : ↑N) : (self.action σ) (c • x) = σ c • (self.action σ) x

      The action respects extension scalars through the field automorphism.

    • map_algebra_smul (σ : Gal(F/k)) (r : R) (x : ↑N) : (self.action σ) ((algebraInclusion k F R) r • x) = (algebraInclusion k F R) r • (self.action σ) x

      The action commutes with the original algebra action.
